en: The Second Part of the Analysis of the Monks' Rules (Bhikkhuvibhaṅga)
1.11 Section on Failure (Vipattivāra) With respect to the offenses conditioned by engaging in sexual intercourse, to how many of the four failures do they belong?
The offenses conditioned by engaging in sexual intercourse belong to two of the four failures.
It may be a failure in virtue;

it may be a failure in conduct… [as before] … Regarding the offense committed due to the act of voiding feces, urine, or spitting in water out of disrespect: to how many of the four failures does this offense belong?
The offense committed due to the act of voiding feces, urine, or spitting in water out of disrespect belongs to one of the four failures—it belongs to the failure in conduct.
The third section on failure is concluded.
